x.h: The Vision of the Cherubim. (b. c. 593.)
p: To inspire us with a holy awe and dread of God, and to fill us with his fear, we may observe, in this part of the vision which the prophet had,
I. The glorious appearance of his majesty. …

x.h: The Vision of the Divine Glory. (b. c. 593.)
p: We have here a further account of the vision of God's glory which Ezekiel saw, here intended to introduce that direful omen of the departure of that glory from them, which would open the door for ruin to break in.
